title: RAIT ACM SIGAI Student Chapter Launch
description: The RAIT ACM SIGAI Student Chapter was officially launched on September 4, 2024, at Ramrao Adik Institute of Technology, Nerul. The event featured guest speaker Miss Naina Gupta Bandopadhyay and guest of honor Mr. Ehsan Ahmed Momim.

title: KAINOS AI Hackathon 2024
description: The KAINOS AI Hackathon 2024 was a 24-hour online competition focused on healthcare, finance, smart cities, and environmental sustainability. Over 1,300 registrations led to 150 finalists competing on September 26, 2024.

title: MongoDB Essentials Workshop
description: The RAIT ACM SIGAI Student Chapter conducted the MongoDB Essentials Workshop on October 4, 2024, at Ramrao Adik Institute of Technology, Nerul. The session was led by Dr. Shubhangi N. Ghate and Dr. Dipti Jadhav.

title: Eminent Speaker Program on Conversational AI
description: The RAIT ACM SIGAI Student Chapter conducted the Eminent Speaker Program on October 9, 2024, featuring Dr. Karthika Vijayan. The online session focused on Conversational AI, its significance, and real-world applications.

title: Expert Talk: The Power of GenAI
description: The RAIT ACM SIGAI Chapter hosted a session on The Power of Generative AI in Data Analytics on October 11, 2024. The event featured Mr. Akshay Ridlan, a Data Engineer, Animal Activist, and Founder of projectchetna.in and Pawfriend.in.

title: IGNASIA AI v1.0
description: The RAIT ACM SIGAI Student Chapter conducted IGNASIA AI V1.0 on October 19, 2024, at Ramrao Adik Institute of Technology, Nerul. The workshop featured speakers Mr. Amey Shete and Mr. Dev Nirmal, engaging participants eager to explore AI and Machine Learning.

title: Hour Of Code
description: The RAIT ACM SIGAI Student Chapter conducted Hour of Code from December 9 to 13, 2024, at Don Bosco High School, Seawoods, Navi Mumbai. Non-core members taught children about Cyber Security, emphasizing online safety and the role of cyber police.

title: Winter Internship Program: Generative AI
description: RAIT ACM SIGAI Student Chapter, in collaboration with the CSE Department, conducted a one-month winter internship on Generative AI from December 16, 2024, to January 16, 2025. Participants explored the fundamentals of Generative AI, including VAEs, GANs, and Transformers.

title: Semantix: NLP & Sentiment Analysis Workshop
description: The SemantiX Workshop on NLP and Sentiment Analysis was a two-day hands-on training conducted by the CSE Department in collaboration with RAIT ACM SIGAI. It introduced participants to NLP fundamentals and practical sentiment analysis model development.

title: Neural Nexus: AI Bootcamp
description: Neural Nexus: AI Bootcamp was conducted by RAIT ACM SIGAI Student Chapter from February 24th to March 1st, 2025 at Ramrao Adik Institute of Technology, Nerul. The week-long event featured panel discussions, coding competitions, debates, ideathons, and hands-on workshops.

title: Harnessing Generative AI
description: The Department of Information Technology, in collaboration with RAIT ACM SIGAI and others, organized a one-day workshop held on 12th April 2025 from 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM at SAKEC, Chembur in a hybrid mode, featuring an insightful session by Mr. Nitin Kukreja from NPCI.

title: AI Meets Quantum: Expert Talk
description: On the occasion of World Quantum Day, the Computer Science Engineering Department of RAIT, in collaboration with the RAIT ACM SIGAI Student Chapter, hosted a National Level Webinar. The event explored the convergence of Artificial Intelligence and Quantum Computing. It was conducted online on 14th April 2025 at 11:00 AM.

title: Exploring GeoAI
description: The Department of Computer Science and Engineering at RAIT, in collaboration with Esri India and the RAIT ACM SIGAI Student Chapter, organized a workshop on “Exploring GeoAI: Spatial Intelligence and Research Applications using ArcGIS.” The session was conducted by Dr. Seema Joshi, Vice President, Strategic Initiatives, Esri India.

title: Generative AI to Agentic AI Workshop
description: The One Week STTP on “Generative to Agentic AI” at RAIT, Nerul, organized by the CSE Department and RAIT ACM SIGAI Student Chapter, concluded after six impactful days of cutting-edge knowledge and hands-on learning.

title: KLEOS 3.0: National Level Hackathon
description: RAIT ACM Student Chapter, in collaboration with ACM-W and SIGAI, hosted KLEOS 3.0 – a national-level hackathon held on 19th July 2025 at Dr. D.Y. Patil’s Ramrao Adik Institute of Technology, Nerul. The event brought together innovation, teamwork, and technical excellence, attracting participation from over 400 teams nationwide.

title: IGNASIA WORKSHOP
description: This comprehensive two-day workshop will guide participants from theory to practice. The first day is dedicated to building a solid foundation in AI and Machine Learning fundamentals. On the second day, attendees will engage in a hands-on session exploring advanced AI tools and their real-world applications. Refreshments will be provided during the event, and every participant will receive a certificate to recognize their completion of the workshop.

title: SYNARA 2025 Magazine Launch
description: Innovation. Intelligence. Impact. SYNARA 2025— a magazine where AI meets imagination, and the future takes form. The RAIT ACM SIGAI Student Chapter proudly unveils its inaugural edition, centred around the theme ‘Generative-AI’. This edition is not just launched — it’s unleashed.

title: Build Your 1st AI MODEL
description: This two-day workshop is designed to guide participants through the process of learning, creating, and launching their first AI project. Day 1 focuses on building a strong foundation, covering an introduction to Python for AI and the fundamentals of Machine Learning. The second day transitions into a practical, hands-on session where attendees will build their first AI model and receive valuable tips for implementation. Refreshments and certificates are included for all participants upon completion.

title: Leveraging AI in Education: MVP Building
description: Join industry professionals Jishanahmed AR Shaikh (Full Stack Developer at PassionBytes) and Kaiser M Momin (Data Analytics Specialist at Benzene Corporation) to learn, build, and innovate with next-gen AI applications. This workshop covers Agentic Workflows for smart automation, practical steps for MVP Building using AI, and the latest AI trends transforming education.

title: ESP: From Past to Future - The Evolution and Advancement of AI
description: Presented under the ACM India Eminent Speaker Programme, this session features Dr. R. Venkateswaran, a global pioneer with over 30 years of experience at Bell Labs, Lucent Technologies, and Persistent Systems. Uncover AI's past, present, and future, and learn from a trailblazer who lived the revolution.

title: RELAI YouTube Lecture 1
description: RELAI (Recorded Education Lectures on Artificial Intelligence) is a monthly lecture series connecting students with global AI experts. This inaugural session features Dr. Jessica Cervi, an AI & Data Science Educator with experience across MIT xPRO, UC Berkeley, and Columbia University. Explore the intersection of AI and cybersecurity, understand emerging risks with generative models, and learn how to build safer, smarter AI systems.

title: Winter Internship on Secure and Intelligent Quantum Computing
description: Organized by the Department of Computer Science and Engineering, D Y Patil Deemed to be University – Ramrao Adik Institute of Technology, this one-month winter internship introduces participants to the world of Secure and Intelligent Quantum Computing. Covering Quantum Computing, Quantum Machine Learning, and Quantum Cybersecurity, the program provides hands-on experience with tools like Qiskit and IBM Quantum Lab, empowering learners to explore the future of computing and AI securely and intelligently.
location: Ramrao Adik Institute of Technology, Nerul, Navi Mumbai
objectives: To introduce participants to the fundamentals of Quantum Computing and Quantum Information Science.
To train participants in implementing Quantum Algorithms and exploring their applications in Machine Learning and AI.
To provide hands-on exposure to tools such as Qiskit, Quantum Simulators, and the IBM Quantum Lab.
To create awareness of Quantum Cybersecurity, Quantum Key Distribution (QKD), and Post-Quantum Threats.
To encourage innovation, research, and project-based learning in futuristic quantum technologies.
theme_scope: Overview of Quantum Computing, Qubits, Quantum Gates, and Quantum Circuits.
Introduction to Quantum AI/ML (QML) and real-world use-cases.
Demonstration of Quantum Cryptography & QKD Protocols for quantum-secure communication.
Exploration of research opportunities and career pathways in Quantum Technologies.
Discussion on ethics, challenges, and global trends in Quantum Computing.
Sessions by experts from Quantum industry, research labs, and academia.
eligibility: Undergraduate, postgraduate, and Ph.D. research scholars with a basic understanding of mathematics, computing, and AI concepts.

title: Hour of AI
description:
A 5-Day Interactive AI & Computing Education Program was conducted to introduce students aged 8–15 to the fundamentals of computing and artificial intelligence through engaging, hands-on learning. The event focused on building curiosity, confidence, and basic digital literacy using interactive storytelling, unplugged activities, games, mini-labs, and guided demonstrations.

Across five days, students explored concepts such as human vs machine intelligence, data and pattern recognition, AI applications and ethics, and hands-on AI simulations. The program concluded with a team-based showcase where participants presented their own AI-inspired ideas. The event encouraged logical thinking, teamwork, creativity, and responsible technology awareness, creating an enjoyable and meaningful learning experience for all participants.

title: Neural Nexus The AI Bootcamp 2026
description: Neural Nexus The AI Bootcamp 2026 is the upcoming edition of our flagship AI Bootcamp, brought to you by RAIT ACM SIGAI Student Chapter. Scheduled for February 2026, this week-long event will feature advanced workshops, hackathons, and expert panels. Stay tuned for more details!

title: Distinguished Speaker Programme: Building Advanced AI Applications and Agents in One Hour
description:
The RAIT ACM SIGAI Student Chapter presents a Distinguished Speaker Programme on 'Building Advanced AI Applications and Agents in One Hour'. This session focuses on practical application, moving beyond theory and demonstrations to build real AI live.

What makes this session exceptional is its hands-on nature, where participants will go from zero to deployed AI agents using cutting-edge Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in a focused sprint.

Distinguished Speaker:
Dr. Mehdi Bahrami
Principal Researcher, Fujitsu Research of America (California)
Senior Member – ACM & IEEE
IEEE Outstanding Engineer Awardee
30+ publications | 34+ US patents
Speaker at Stanford, CMU, ACM & IEEE Conferences

Key Learning Outcomes:
- Building full-stack AI applications powered by LLMs & VLMs
- Design and deployment of intelligent AI agents
- Prompting, fine-tuning, and model selection (LLaMA & open-source models)
- NLP, Computer Vision, decision-making, and automation
- Scalable architectures, efficiency, and AI ethics

title: Robust AI Workshop
description: Breaking Systems to Build Robust Intelligence. A hands-on workshop focused on AI failure analysis, adversarial testing, and building more robust intelligent systems. Participants will stress-test real AI models, expose weaknesses, manipulate image and detection systems with minimal changes, understand how AI systems interpret inputs, and apply techniques to improve model robustness.

title: Kleos 4.0
description: Kleos 4.0 is a national-level 24-hour hackathon organized by the RAIT ACM Committee under Dr. D.Y. Patil Deemed to be University. Conducted collaboratively by RAIT ACM, ACM-W, ACM SIGAI, and ACM SC chapters, the event brings together students from across the country to build innovative solutions across multiple technology domains.

title: Spatial Intelligence Workshop 2026
description: A three-day hands-on workshop organized by the Department of Computer Science and Engineering in collaboration with EDS Technologies and the RAIT ACM SIGAI Student Chapter. Participants explored Geographic Information Systems (GIS), GeoAI, satellite image analysis, ArcGIS, Google Earth Engine, and cloud-scale geospatial analytics through practical laboratory sessions.
location: Lab 301, Geoinformatics Lab, Ramrao Adik Institute of Technology, Nerul

title: Summer Internship Programme 2026 on Intelligent Data Analytics
description: A one-month internship organized by the Department of Computer Science and Engineering in collaboration with the RAIT ACM SIGAI Student Chapter. The programme covered Python for Data Analytics, Exploratory Data Analysis, Machine Learning, Streamlit deployment, Power BI, and a guided project phase, enabling participants to build AI-driven, data-driven solutions for real-world applications.
location: Lab 413, Ramrao Adik Institute of Technology, Nerul
objectives: Develop strong foundations in Python programming for data analytics.
Perform exploratory data analysis and feature engineering on real-world datasets.
Build and evaluate machine learning models using industry-standard workflows.
Deploy interactive AI applications using Streamlit.
Create business intelligence dashboards using Power BI.
Complete an end-to-end guided analytics project with industry mentorship.
theme_scope: Data Visualization using Matplotlib and Seaborn
eligibility: Undergraduate engineering students with basic programming knowledge and an interest in Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, and Machine Learning.

title: OMEGA 2026
description: OMEGA is a 2-phase journey from Python fundamentals to the foundations of AI & Machine Learning, organized by RAIT ACM SIGAI Student Chapter. Phase 01 covers Python Foundations including Variables, Data Types, Loops, Functions, OOP Concepts, NumPy & Pandas. Phase 02 covers Machine Learning including AI & ML Fundamentals, Machine Learning Concepts, House Price Prediction Model, and Project Development. Participants also get to build their own Calculator, Password Generator, and Quiz Game.
location: 413 Lab, Ramrao Adik Institute of Technology, Nerul
